loop.tpl.autoFix.desc: Run tests → analyze failures → fix code → verify pass, loop until all pass
loop.tpl.autoFix.name: Auto-fix Loop
loop.tpl.autoFix.prompt: Run the project test suite, collect all failed test cases; analyze the root cause of each failure (check assertions, logic, dependencies), fix the corresponding source code; commit fixes and confirm all tests pass. If an unfixable blocking issue is encountered, record the reason in detail and pause
loop.tpl.codeReview.desc: Review yesterday's commits at 9 AM daily, auto-identify risks and generate review report
loop.tpl.codeReview.name: Code Review Assistant
loop.tpl.codeReview.prompt: Extract change summaries (by file category) from all commits between yesterday 00:00 and today 08:00. Check for risks: unhandled errors, hardcoded keys, SQL injection risks, memory leaks, logic vulnerabilities. Output a summary report with risk levels (high/medium/low) and provide fix suggestions for high-risk items
loop.tpl.depSecurity.desc: Periodically scan project dependencies for known vulnerabilities and outdated versions
loop.tpl.depSecurity.name: Dependency Security Scan
loop.tpl.depSecurity.prompt: Scan all direct and transitive dependencies of the project. Check: 1) known security vulnerabilities (CVE) and their severity 2) whether versions are outdated (latest stable vs current) 3) compatibility conflicts between dependencies. Summarize as a dependency health report, annotate each issue with suggested action (upgrade/downgrade/replace/ignore), and highlight critical vulnerabilities separately
loop.tpl.testCoverage.desc: Scan uncovered code, progressively add unit tests by priority until target met
loop.tpl.testCoverage.name: Test Coverage Guard
loop.tpl.testCoverage.prompt: Run the test coverage tool, list untested modules/methods; sort by priority (core logic > boundary conditions > utility functions), write missing unit tests one by one; re-check coverage after each commit, iterate until target coverage is achieved
